The '''Chattza militia''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] military force of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] of the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]] on the Rodian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. Chattza [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]] compromised its ranks.
